rows: Verify the fire truck's trial operation and that it is serviceable.
Verify that the siren is working.
Verify that the flasher is working.
Second: Dry Chemical Powder Fire-Extinguishing System
Verify the powder tank body is free of corrosion or holes and carry out the necessary maintenance (scraping and repainting) when required.
Replace the expired powder with fresh powder valid for five years and verify that the powder tank is filled with the ideal quantity.
Verify that the refilling opening is tightly closed to maintain the ideal operating pressure.
Record the refilling date and the validity period on a sticker and place it in a visible location on the powder tank body.
Carry out the body test of the two nitrogen cylinders, refill them to the ideal pressure, seal them and return them to their designated place.
Verify the serviceability of the powder accessories: the valves, hoses and pressure gauges.
Third: Fire Truck Accessories
Verify the presence of fire-resistant suits with their accessories.
Verify the presence of a breathing apparatus and that it is serviceable.
Verify the presence of rescue equipment (ropes – shears – crowbar – axe ...).
Verify that the fire truck's ladder is serviceable.

Introduction
This document sets out the steps of the 5-yearly inspection of the powder fire-extinguishing system used on fire trucks.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Osama Ismail El-Mashad, tested by Eng. El-Sayed Ahmed El-Desouky and reviewed by Eng. Mostafa El-Nady Abdel Rahman.
It was endorsed by Eng. Farouk Awad Ali, Head of the Talkha Power Station Sector.
It was reviewed and approved by Eng. Ibrahim Youssef Youssef, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil Ahmed, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's coordinator for the Maintenance Procedures Information System, and documented by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet – safety shoes – overalls – gloves ...).

Procedures to be Carried Out — First: General Procedures
1. | Verify the fire truck's trial operation and that it is serviceable.
2. | Verify that the siren is working.
3. | Verify that the flasher is working.
Second: Dry Chemical Powder Fire-Extinguishing System
1. | Verify the powder tank body is free of corrosion or holes and carry out the necessary maintenance (scraping and repainting) when required.
2. | Replace the expired powder with fresh powder valid for five years and verify that the powder tank is filled with the ideal quantity.
3. | Verify that the refilling opening is tightly closed to maintain the ideal operating pressure.
4. | Record the refilling date and the validity period on a sticker and place it in a visible location on the powder tank body.
5. | Carry out the body test of the two nitrogen cylinders, refill them to the ideal pressure, seal them and return them to their designated place.
6. | Verify the serviceability of the powder accessories: the valves, hoses and pressure gauges.
Third: Fire Truck Accessories
1. | Verify the presence of fire-resistant suits with their accessories.
2. | Verify the presence of a breathing apparatus and that it is serviceable.
3. | Verify the presence of rescue equipment (ropes – shears – crowbar – axe ...).
4. | Verify that the fire truck's ladder is serviceable.
